query:
SELECT pm.plant_id, p.name as plant_name, pm.molecule_id, m.name as mol_name, m.family
FROM plant_molecules pm
JOIN plants p ON p.id = pm.plant_id
JOIN molecules m ON m.id = pm.molecule_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Nicotiana%' OR p.name LIKE '%Virginia%' OR p.name LIKE '%Burley%' OR p.name LIKE '%Latakia%' OR p.name LIKE '%Samsun%' OR p.name LIKE '%Caporal%'
AND m.name IN ('Guaiacol','Phénol','Catéchol','Crésol','Syringol','Bêta-damascone','Dihydro-β-ionone')
ORDER BY p.name, m.name
LIMIT 30;
